 Talking points
 Underrated Kings
 It’s very rare that a reigning champion would fly under the radar the following season, yet it seems the Sydney Kings are doing just that. No experts tipped the Kings to go back-to-back in the pre-season, and star guard Kendric Davis told NBL Now this week that’s just the way they want it. The Kings have been juggling some missing pieces so far in NBL27 and have still found a way to pile on the wins. While Davis has been his dominant self, it’s Torrey Craig who is quickly showing just why he forged such an impressive NBA career.
 Snakes alive
 The Cairns Taipans bounced back from a pair of poor performances to claw out a win over the Wildcats in Perth. Led by the brilliance of Jack McVeigh, this Cairns team showed just how many weapons they have when they are locked in and unselfish on the offensive end. Now the task for Adam Forde is to get his team to consistently replicate that version of themselves.
